exercises.prompt_bn: Exploratory finding new data-তে validate করা উচিত কেন?
exercises.answer_en: Patterns selected after inspecting the same data may reflect chance, multiple comparisons, or temporary conditions.
exercises.answer_bn: Same data inspect করে selected pattern chance, multiple comparison বা temporary condition reflect করতে পারে।

recap.en: EDA begins with question and structure.
recap.bn: EDA question ও structure দিয়ে শুরু হয়।

recap.en: Quality checks come before interpretation.
recap.bn: Interpretation-এর আগে quality check।

recap.en: Move from simple summaries to focused comparisons.
recap.bn: Simple summary থেকে focused comparison-এ যান।

recap.en: Exploratory patterns are provisional.
recap.bn: Exploratory pattern provisional।

references.title: NIST/SEMATECH — First Steps in Data Analysis

chapters.summary_en: Reproducible work allows another person—or your future self—to understand the data, repeat the steps, and obtain the same result. Learn practical documentation and versioning habits.
chapters.summary_bn: Reproducible work অন্য person বা future self-কে data বুঝতে, step repeat করতে এবং same result পেতে সাহায্য করে। Practical documentation ও versioning habit শিখুন।

objectives.bn: Reproducibility ও traceability explain করুন।
Minimum analysis record তৈরি করুন।

objectives.en: Separate raw, processed, and output data.
objectives.bn: Raw, processed ও output data আলাদা করুন।
Assumption, transformation ও version document করুন।

sections.body_en: A reproducible analysis has identifiable inputs, documented steps, stable definitions, and saved outputs so the result can be regenerated. Reproducibility is not limited to code: Excel workbooks, SQL scripts, Power BI models, and manual procedures also need documentation.
sections.body_bn: Reproducible analysis-এ identifiable input, documented step, stable definition ও saved output থাকে যাতে result regenerate করা যায়। শুধু code নয়; Excel workbook, SQL script, Power BI model ও manual procedure-ও document করতে হয়।

sections.body_en: Keep raw source files unchanged and read-only. Store cleaned or transformed data separately. Store reports and figures as outputs. This separation makes it possible to trace a result back to original evidence and rerun transformations when rules change.
sections.body_bn: Raw source file unchanged ও read-only রাখুন। Cleaned/ transformed data separately। Report ও figure output হিসেবে। এতে result original evidence পর্যন্ত trace ও rule change হলে transformation rerun করা যায়।

sections.body_en: Record the question, owner, source, extraction date, field definitions, row grain, exclusions, cleaning rules, formulas or queries, software versions, validation checks, output location, and known limitations. A README and data dictionary can cover much of this.
sections.body_bn: Question, owner, source, extraction date, field definition, row grain, exclusion, cleaning rule, formula/query, software version, validation check, output location ও limitation record করুন। README ও data dictionary অনেকটা cover করে।

sections.body_en: Use meaningful filenames or version control for scripts and documentation. Avoid overwriting evidence without a record. When a metric definition changes, note the effective date and whether historical values were restated.
sections.body_bn: Script ও documentation-এর জন্য meaningful filename বা version control ব্যবহার করুন। Record ছাড়া evidence overwrite করবেন না। Metric definition change হলে effective date ও historical value restated কি না note করুন।

terms.definition_en: Ability to repeat an analysis using documented inputs and steps.
terms.definition_bn: Documented input ও step দিয়ে analysis repeat করার ability।

terms.definition_en: Trace of how data moved and changed from source to output.
terms.definition_bn: Source থেকে output পর্যন্ত data কীভাবে move ও change হয়েছে তার trace।

terms.definition_en: Definitions, types, units, codes, and rules for fields.
terms.definition_bn: Field-এর definition, type, unit, code ও rule।

terms.definition_en: A system or practice for recording changes over time.
terms.definition_bn: সময়ের সঙ্গে change record করার system বা practice।

worked_example.context_en: An analyst combines three project-expense CSVs and calculates budget utilization.
worked_example.context_bn: Analyst তিনটি project-expense CSV combine করে budget utilization calculate করেন।
steps_en: Save original files under raw/ with dates and checksums if appropriate.
Document column definitions and currency.
Store cleaning and mapping rules.
Save the calculation formula and denominator definition.
Record software version, run date, and quality checks.
Publish output with limitations and source links.
steps_bn: Original file raw/ folder-এ date ও প্রয়োজন হলে checksum-সহ save করুন।
Column definition ও currency document করুন।
Cleaning ও mapping rule store করুন।
Calculation formula ও denominator definition save করুন।
Software version, run date ও quality check record করুন।
Limitation ও source link-সহ output publish করুন।
worked_example.conclusion_en: Documentation turns an isolated result into an auditable analytical product.
worked_example.conclusion_bn: Documentation isolated result-কে auditable analytical product-এ রূপ দেয়।

activity.prompt_en: Build a minimum README checklist for an analysis.
activity.prompt_bn: Analysis-এর minimum README checklist তৈরি করুন।

exercises.prompt_en: Which practice best supports reproducibility?
exercises.prompt_bn: কোন practice reproducibility best support করে?
options_en: A. Manually editing the only raw file
C. Preserving raw data and documenting transformations
options_bn: A. একমাত্র raw file manually edit
C. Raw data preserve ও transformation document

exercises.prompt_en: The trace from original source through transformations to output is data ____.
exercises.prompt_bn: Original source থেকে transformation হয়ে output পর্যন্ত trace হলো data ____.

exercises.prompt_en: List four items that belong in an analysis README.
exercises.prompt_bn: Analysis README-তে থাকা চারটি item লিখুন।
exercises.answer_en: Examples: question, data source, extraction date, grain, definitions, transformations, validation, software version, outputs, limitations.
exercises.answer_bn: উদাহরণ: question, source, extraction date, grain, definition, transformation, validation, software version, output, limitation।

recap.en: Preserve raw evidence.
recap.bn: Raw evidence preserve করুন।

recap.en: Document inputs, steps, definitions, and versions.
recap.bn: Input, step, definition ও version document করুন।

recap.en: Separate raw, processed, and output files.
recap.bn: Raw, processed ও output file আলাদা করুন।

recap.en: Lineage makes results auditable.
recap.bn: Lineage result auditable করে।

chapters.title_en: Data Ethics, Privacy, and Responsible Use
chapters.title_bn: Data Ethics, Privacy ও Responsible Use
chapters.summary_en: Legal permission is not the only test. Learn purpose limitation, data minimization, privacy, security, fairness, transparency, and responsible communication.
chapters.summary_bn: Legal permission একমাত্র test নয়। Purpose limitation, data minimization, privacy, security, fairness, transparency ও responsible communication শিখুন।

objectives.en: Identify ethical risks across the data lifecycle.
objectives.bn: Data lifecycle জুড়ে ethical risk identify করুন।

objectives.en: Apply purpose limitation and data minimization.
objectives.bn: Purpose limitation ও data minimization apply করুন।

objectives.en: Distinguish anonymisation from simple removal of names.
objectives.bn: Anonymisation ও শুধু name removal আলাদা করুন।
Uncertainty ও limitation honestly communicate করুন।

sections.body_en: Collect and use data for a clear, legitimate purpose. Ask whether each field is necessary and whether a less intrusive method can answer the question. Data collected for one purpose should not silently be repurposed in ways people would not reasonably expect.
sections.body_bn: Clear, legitimate purpose-এর জন্য data collect/use করুন। প্রতিটি field necessary কি না এবং less intrusive method question answer করতে পারে কি না জিজ্ঞেস করুন। এক purpose-এর data people reasonably expect করবে না এমনভাবে silently repurpose করবেন না।

sections.body_en: Privacy concerns appropriate collection, access, use, sharing, and retention. Security protects data against unauthorized access, alteration, and loss. Removing names is not always anonymisation: combinations of age, location, date, or rare events may re-identify people.
sections.body_bn: Privacy appropriate collection, access, use, sharing ও retention নিয়ে। Security unauthorized access, alteration ও loss থেকে protect করে। Name remove করলেই anonymisation নয়; age, location, date বা rare event combination re-identify করতে পারে।

sections.body_en: Data and models can disadvantage groups through missing coverage, historical inequity, biased labels, unsuitable proxies, or unequal error rates. Assess subgroup performance and harms, not only overall accuracy. Avoid using protected or sensitive characteristics without a defensible need and safeguards.
sections.body_bn: Missing coverage, historical inequity, biased label, unsuitable proxy বা unequal error rate-এর মাধ্যমে data/model group disadvantage করতে পারে। শুধু overall accuracy নয়, subgroup performance ও harm assess করুন। Sensitive characteristic defensible need ও safeguard ছাড়া use করবেন না।

sections.body_en: Do not exaggerate causality, precision, or certainty. Show denominators, time periods, definitions, and important uncertainty. Avoid visual scales and selective filters that mislead. State who may be missing and what decision the evidence cannot support.
sections.body_bn: Causality, precision বা certainty exaggerate করবেন না। Denominator, time period, definition ও important uncertainty দেখান। Misleading visual scale ও selective filter এড়ান। কে missing এবং evidence কোন decision support করে না তা state করুন।

terms.definition_en: Collecting and retaining only data necessary for a defined purpose.
terms.definition_bn: Defined purpose-এর জন্য necessary data-ই collect ও retain করা।

terms.definition_en: Processing data so individuals are no longer identifiable with reasonably available means.
terms.definition_bn: Reasonably available means দিয়ে individual আর identifiable না থাকে এমন processing।

terms.definition_en: Assessment of whether data use creates unjustified unequal benefits, errors, or harms.
terms.definition_bn: Data use unjustified unequal benefit, error বা harm তৈরি করে কি না assessment।

terms.definition_en: Using data only for specified, legitimate, compatible purposes.
terms.definition_bn: Specified, legitimate ও compatible purpose-এ data use করা।

worked_example.context_en: A public dashboard would show monthly visits by area, age group, diagnosis category, and clinic.
worked_example.context_bn: Public dashboard monthly visit area, age group, diagnosis category ও clinic অনুযায়ী দেখাবে।
steps_en: Confirm public reporting purpose and legal basis.
Remove unnecessary fields and use aggregated groups.
Assess small cells and combinations that may identify individuals.
Apply access, suppression, and retention controls.
Review subgroup fairness and stigmatizing labels.
Publish definitions, coverage, and limitations.
steps_bn: Public reporting purpose ও legal basis confirm করুন।
Unnecessary field remove ও aggregated group ব্যবহার করুন।
Small cell ও identifying combination assess করুন।
Access, suppression ও retention control apply করুন।
Subgroup fairness ও stigmatizing label review করুন।
Definition, coverage ও limitation publish করুন।
worked_example.conclusion_en: Responsible publication balances usefulness with privacy, fairness, and the risk of harm.
worked_example.conclusion_bn: Responsible publication usefulness-এর সঙ্গে privacy, fairness ও harm risk balance করে।

activity.prompt_en: Review a proposed analysis using a six-part ethics checklist.
activity.prompt_bn: Six-part ethics checklist দিয়ে proposed analysis review করুন।

exercises.prompt_en: Which statement about anonymisation is most accurate?
exercises.prompt_bn: Anonymisation সম্পর্কে কোন statement most accurate?
options_en: A. Removing names always anonymises data
B. Re-identification risk from combinations and external information must be assessed
C. Anonymous data never requires security
options_bn: B. Combination ও external information থেকে re-identification risk assess করতে হয়
C. Anonymous data-তে security লাগে না

exercises.prompt_en: Collecting only fields necessary for the stated purpose is data ____.
exercises.prompt_bn: Stated purpose-এর জন্য necessary field-ই collect করা data ____.

exercises.prompt_en: Name two ways an honest chart or report should communicate limitations.
exercises.prompt_bn: Honest chart/report limitation communicate করার দুইটি way লিখুন।
exercises.answer_en: Examples: show denominators and time periods, state missing groups, include uncertainty, disclose definition changes, avoid causal wording.
exercises.answer_bn: উদাহরণ: denominator/time period দেখানো, missing group state, uncertainty include, definition change disclose, causal wording avoid।

recap.en: Use data for clear and compatible purposes.
recap.bn: Clear ও compatible purpose-এ data ব্যবহার করুন।

recap.en: Minimize collection and access.
recap.bn: Collection ও access minimize করুন।

recap.en: Removing names may not prevent re-identification.
recap.bn: Name remove করলেও re-identification prevent নাও হতে পারে।

recap.en: Fairness and honest communication are analytical responsibilities.
recap.bn: Fairness ও honest communication analytical responsibility।

chapters.title_en: Mini Project: Audit a Retail Dataset
chapters.summary_en: Apply the entire Data Foundations tutorial to a documented retail-sales CSV. Define questions, inspect structure, profile quality, organize findings, and write a responsible analytical brief.
chapters.summary_bn: Documented retail-sales CSV-তে পুরো Data Foundations tutorial apply করুন। Question define, structure inspect, quality profile, finding organize ও responsible analytical brief লিখুন।

objectives.en: Audit a dataset from question to documented findings.
objectives.bn: Question থেকে documented finding পর্যন্ত dataset audit করুন।

objectives.en: Apply structure, type, quality, and ethics checks.
objectives.bn: Structure, type, quality ও ethics check apply করুন।
Concise data-readiness report তৈরি করুন।

objectives.en: Prepare the dataset for future Excel, SQL, Power BI, and Python work.
objectives.bn: Future Excel, SQL, Power BI ও Python work-এর জন্য dataset prepare করুন।

sections.body_en: You are supporting a retail manager who wants to understand sales performance by month, region, channel, and product category. Before analysis, you must determine whether the provided synthetic dataset is structurally and analytically ready.
sections.body_bn: আপনি retail manager-কে month, region, channel ও product category অনুযায়ী sales performance বুঝতে support করছেন। Analysis-এর আগে synthetic dataset structurally ও analytically ready কি না determine করতে হবে।

sections.body_en: Document the row grain, key fields, data types, time coverage, source assumptions, and target questions. Profile row count, duplicate keys, missing required values, invalid categories, impossible quantities, arithmetic consistency, and extreme revenue or profit values.
sections.body_bn: Row grain, key field, data type, time coverage, source assumption ও target question document করুন। Row count, duplicate key, missing required value, invalid category, impossible quantity, arithmetic consistency ও extreme revenue/profit profile করুন।

sections.body_en: After quality checks, calculate a small set of descriptive outputs: total revenue, total profit, order count, median order value, monthly trend, top categories, regional contribution, and loss-making observations. Keep business findings separate from data-quality findings.
sections.body_bn: Quality check-এর পর total revenue, total profit, order count, median order value, monthly trend, top category, regional contribution ও loss-making observation calculate করুন। Business finding data-quality finding থেকে আলাদা রাখুন।

sections.body_en: Produce a one-page data-readiness brief with: question, dataset scope, grain, quality scorecard, three evidence-based findings, one limitation, one recommended next analysis, and a change log. Save any cleaned file separately from the original.
sections.body_bn: এক-page data-readiness brief: question, dataset scope, grain, quality scorecard, তিন evidence-based finding, এক limitation, এক recommended next analysis ও change log। Cleaned file original থেকে separately save করুন।

terms.definition_en: A documented review of structure, quality, provenance, and fitness for use.
terms.definition_bn: Structure, quality, provenance ও fitness-for-use-এর documented review।

terms.definition_en: The degree to which data can safely support a defined analytical purpose.
terms.definition_bn: Defined analytical purpose safely support করার degree।

terms.definition_en: A concise report of checks, failures, severity, and action.
terms.definition_bn: Check, failure, severity ও action-এর concise report।

terms.definition_en: A record of transformations and corrections applied to data.
terms.definition_bn: Data-তে applied transformation ও correction-এর record।

worked_example.context_en: Use the included retail_sales.csv and data dictionary.
worked_example.context_bn: Included retail_sales.csv ও data dictionary ব্যবহার করুন।
steps_en: Read the project brief and write three analytical questions.
Inspect the data dictionary and confirm one-row meaning.
Profile structure and quality before calculating KPIs.
Create summary tables and one trend chart.
Investigate at least one unusual value.
Write findings with units, time period, and limitations.
Save a README and change log.
steps_bn: Project brief পড়ে তিন analytical question লিখুন।
Data dictionary inspect করে one-row meaning confirm করুন।
KPI calculate-এর আগে structure ও quality profile করুন।
Summary table ও একটি trend chart তৈরি করুন।
কমপক্ষে একটি unusual value investigate করুন।
Unit, time period ও limitation-সহ finding লিখুন।
README ও change log save করুন।
worked_example.conclusion_en: The project is complete when another learner can understand your question, repeat the audit, and trace each conclusion to evidence.
worked_example.conclusion_bn: অন্য learner আপনার question বুঝতে, audit repeat এবং প্রতিটি conclusion evidence-এ trace করতে পারলে project complete।

activity.prompt_en: Track the seven project deliverables and download the dataset.
activity.prompt_bn: সাত project deliverable track করুন এবং dataset download করুন।

exercises.prompt_en: What should happen before calculating business KPIs?
exercises.prompt_bn: Business KPI calculate-এর আগে কী করা উচিত?
options_en: A. Confirm grain, types, and data quality
B. Design the final dashboard colors
options_bn: A. Grain, type ও data quality confirm

exercises.prompt_en: A cleaned file should be saved separately from the ____ source file.
exercises.prompt_bn: Cleaned file ____ source file থেকে separately save করা উচিত।

exercises.prompt_en: Write one quality finding and one business finding as separate statements.
exercises.prompt_bn: একটি quality finding ও একটি business finding separate statement হিসেবে লিখুন।
exercises.answer_en: Quality: 3% of rows have missing region. Business: After excluding unresolved rows, the North region contributed 28% of recorded revenue.
exercises.answer_bn: Quality: 3% row-এ region missing। Business: Unresolved row বাদ দিলে North region recorded revenue-এর 28% contribute করেছে।

recap.en: Define questions before calculating.
recap.bn: Calculate-এর আগে question define করুন।

recap.en: Audit structure and quality before business interpretation.
recap.bn: Business interpretation-এর আগে structure ও quality audit করুন।

recap.en: Separate quality findings from business findings.
recap.bn: Quality finding ও business finding আলাদা করুন।

recap.en: Preserve raw data and document changes.
recap.bn: Raw data preserve ও change document করুন।
